certificado.noPudimosComprobarlo: We could not check it right now
certificado.noPudimosComprobarloAyuda: Try again in a few minutes. Not being able to check it now does not mean the certificate is invalid.
certificado.queSeHaComprobado: We have checked the document's digital signature, not merely that it exists in our records: if anyone had changed a name or a date, this page would say so. Signed with key {huella}, which you can download to check it yourself.
certificado.fueAnuladoAyuda: It existed and we issued it, but the school revoked it afterwards. If you need to know why, ask whoever gave it to you.
certificado.haSidoAlteradoAyuda: The serial exists in our records, but the details do not match what we signed. Do not accept it.
certificado.noLoEncontramos: We could not find this certificate
certificado.noLoEncontramosAyuda: We have not issued any certificate with the serial {serie}. Check that you have copied it correctly: it is written in four blocks separated by dashes.
certificado.noActivos: Certificates are not switched on yet
certificado.noActivosAyuda: This platform does not have certificate signing set up yet. Talk to your school.
certificado.noPudimosCargar: We could not load your certificates
certificado.noPudimosCargarAyuda: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell your teacher.
certificado.todaviaNinguno: You do not have any certificate yet
certificado.todaviaNingunoAyuda: One is issued when you finish every lesson of a course. You are nearly there.
certificado.escaneaParaComprobar: Scan to check that it is genuine
